reviews_h2: What people are saying about the electrical

reviews.author: Marie Morgan
reviews.text: I had talked to multiple electricians to help with the electrical work for my remodel before finding Don. Trying to get pricing and even someone to call you back is nothing short of frustrating. Not with Don, he answered my calls, gave me an estimate and was able to start a lot sooner than I thought would be possible. Most important he has answered every call, answered every question and has actually been there when he said he was going to there. I highly recommend using Don and his crew!

reviews.author: Anthony Boswell
reviews.text: The crew of three men called and let me know they were going to be a few minutes later than promised( that is a plus in my book, they let me know). When they got here they assessed the current house wiring and listened to what I wanted. (120 volt 30 Amp outlet for my camper) They came up with least expensive way to make it happen. And presto there it is. I now have full power in my camper DONE RIGHT and in a timely manner. Great job guys , I will call again.

reviews.author: Vernon McCormick
reviews.text: ElectronixxLLC installed power to my greenhouse on the highest professional and technical level I did not request or would never have imagined. I am so happy and impressed with ElectronixxLLC that I hope they will always be in business and available when I need electrical/electronics work, otherwise I am willing to wait upon their availability or accept their referrals only.. Why do I give the highest review i know how is because Don,Chris & Don stated professional ethics are to work and treat people as they would want to serviced or treated. And if you have questions they answer or explain but they finish the job with phrase " are we good, anything else, are you pleased with final product." This company team goes above and beyond all expectations.

reviews.author: Jonathan Harrell
reviews.text: Needed a ceiling fan installed and batteries replaced in my smoke detectors. Chris and Travis did awesome work. I highly recommend them to anyone who needs any electrical work done!

reviews.author: Nathan Parsons
reviews.text: I really hate to leave this review, but on the day I scheduled an estimate, 5 guys showed up ready to do the work. I wasnt about to agree to anything on the spot as I always gather 3 quotes. After all bids were collected and I agreed to have them come back, the date we agreed to was pushed back due to another job running behind (happens to me too). Then a week later on the date we moved the installation to, that also was cancelled because they had been rained out on another site and they needed to catch up. I only found out when I called them after waiting around 2+ hours. If you get rained out at one job look to find others to move up. I would have been happy to adjust. Left me disappointed and I moved on to other tradesmen.

reviews.author: julie elms
reviews.text: I needed several circuit breakers moved and was dealing with a different electrician who had an I can't do it attitude. I called Don for a second opinion and what a difference. No only did he come in at a much more reasonable price. He answered my phone call, showed up on time, and worked until the job was done even though it was late. He had a can do attitude, listened to my needs and got the job done. I couldn't be happier. If I have any additional electrical needs, I know who I am going to call . . .Don at Electronixx in Rocky Mount.

reviews.author: Karen Wright Fairley
reviews.text: Don was courteous, professional and responsive. I appreciated his candor and thoroughness. To me he is a dying breed...caring about his work, staff and customers. I would recommend him and will use him whenever the need arise with out hesitation.

reviews.author: Media Richardson
reviews.text: My outlets kick out when anything was plugged into kitchen outlets. Someone had looked at this before and didn’t quite fix the problem. Plug one thing in outlet and the Fridge would stop. These guys fixed the problem and l am just tickled. Told my daughter about them. I will definitely use them again. Price was reasonable too.

reviews.author: James Reid
reviews.text: Called to let us know that they were running behind but would be here today. Called again to let me know they were on the way. Work was accomplished professionally and at a fair price. Highly recommend this team.

reviews.author: Becky Oneal
reviews.text: Don is very good at what he does. Very courteous and polite. Known him for 59 yrs and now he's doing what he wanted to do. I would recommend him to anyone that needs any electrical work done. Thank you Don for doing what you do.

reviews.author: Emily Eubanks
reviews.text: I had a long list of things that needed to be done. Don showed up on time, stayed until everything was completed, and gave me a fair price. I will definitely call him in the future.

reviews.author: Rosemary Atkinson
reviews.text: Mr.Don give me estimate time of arrival they were on point less then 5 minutes found the problem fixed it called me the next to make sure everything is still going good thanks a million Electronixx LLC

reviews.author: Tamara Glover
reviews.text: I tried to hire him... we made an appointment to meet at my house Saturday at 10:00am. I waited, no call/no show.

reviews.author: Janese Cherry
reviews.text: He's amazing if you want it done right then he is the guy you need to call. I'll definitely used him in the future.
